title: Burning City Quarter
name: scene_burning_quarter
scene_summary: A wide cobbled city street and open plaza on fire, with a large stone house on the west side and a tenement to the north, a toppled waggon spilling sacks across the stones, and a big open fountain square that the fire has not reached yet, the city gate closing the street at the south end.
render_details: Grey cobbles wet with spilled oil, charred timber and splintered planks, smashed carts, burst barrels, orange flame in the windows of the burning houses, thick black smoke, drifting embers, soot-blackened stone, clean water in a carved basin, heavy timber gates bound with iron

rooms.label: Stone House
rooms.description: The ground floor of a large stone house on the west side of the street, still standing and still whole as one undivided space, its floor strewn with overturned furniture and fallen plaster, firelight and thick smoke spilling in through its doorway from the burning street.

rooms.label: Burning Tenement
rooms.description: A tenement building on the north side of the street, well alight, its stair hall full of smoke and burning beams fallen right across the floor.

rooms.label: Fountain Square
rooms.description: A big open plaza of grey cobbles filling the whole east side, completely open to the sky and seamlessly joined with the street, with the carved stone fountain standing free at its centre full of clean water and benches under clipped bushes standing loose about the open cobbles, completely free of fire.

rooms.label: Burning Street
rooms.description: A wide open stretch of cobbled road running the length of the map in front of the house and the square, the stones clear and readable from edge to edge with scattered burnt debris on them, a few patches of the cobbles themselves alight and spilled oil darkening the joints.

rooms.label: Burning Warehouse
rooms.description: A corner warehouse on the south side of the street, flames running across its floor between fallen shelves and spilled stock.

annotations.label: Toppled Waggon
annotations.description: A big four-wheeled waggon lying over on its side in the middle of the open street, its load of sacks spilled out across the cobbles around it and a slick of dark oil spreading from underneath it

annotations.label: Stone Fountain
annotations.description: A carved stone fountain standing at the centre of the open square, its octagonal basin full of clean clear water, the open cobbles around it wet and completely free of fire

annotations.label: Burning Gallery
annotations.description: A ruined timber gallery bridging the gap between the Stone House and the Burning Tenement, well alight along its whole length, its boards burnt through in places and burning fragments fallen on the ground beneath it

annotations.label: City Gate
annotations.description: A pair of great timber city gates bound with iron closing the south end of the street, set in a short stone gatehouse wall that runs a few paces to either side of the gates and simply ends, one leaf standing part open

annotations.label: Fallen Beam
annotations.description: A massive burning timber beam fallen right across the open street, flame running along its whole length and the cobbles scorched black beneath it

annotations.label: Spilled Masonry
annotations.description: A heap of broken stone and charred timber spilled flat across the open cobbles, spread wide and still smoking

annotations.label: Burning Cobbles
annotations.description: A stretch of open cobbles running with burning oil, low flame spread flat across the stones rather than rising from anything standing on them
